notes_for_editor: The location is uncertain: Willhite's map rests on secondhand notes, and his 1944 and 1951 aerial photos appear to show a tower that predates the 1953 date. The story reports this without choosing. Willhite places the site inside a naval base, so no visit is suggested. The Air Warning Service station on the Forest Lookouts page is described as a separate kind of structure and is not merged into this record. Web search budget for this run ran out before the searches for this tower, so the story rests on the cached pages only.
